dedupe_keys.name: dataset from the systematic literature review on building energy flexibility 2019 to 2024

description: Emil Hristov and colleagues at the GATE Institute and partner universities publish a structured extraction from 191 building-energy-flexibility studies dated 2019–2024. The October 2025 workbook is freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. Each row identifies a publication and records its building type, system scale, modelling choices, input and output parameters, flexibility metrics, algorithms and tools. This catalogue of methods can help select simulation approaches, locate benchmarks and compare the temporal or spatial detail used in demand-response research. It does not contain raw building measurements or a directly executable model. The provider describes PRISMA-based screening, but completeness and comparability of reported performance metrics remain uncertain without checking the individual studies. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this extraction. The XLSX inventory and documented field groups were inspected; the workbook and its quality criteria were not independently audited.
